Most apps will be paused and won’t show notifications. Select your essential apps so you don’t miss important notifications or messages. To save the most battery, only choose critical apps.

Most apps will be paused. You can still make calls, receive text messages, and unpause apps that you need.\n\nYour Battery Saver level will be changed from default to extreme. You can change this in Settings at any time.
